name: @pantoken/ai
description: Agent assets for projects that use pantoken: AGENTS.md, llms.txt, Cursor/Copilot/Windsurf rules, and init-pantoken/create-pantoken-app Claude Code skills, with an installer CLI (init, scaffold <platform>).

scripts.translate: I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND=claude I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --effort low" i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" translate cli.ai
scripts.translate:agy: I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tools/translation-adapters/agy-wrapper.sh" I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model gemini-3.6-flash-low" i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" translate cli.ai
scripts.translate:copilot: I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tools/translation-adapters/copilot-wrapper.sh" I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model gpt-5-mini --effort low" i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" translate cli.ai
scripts.check: vp check && i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" check cli.ai
